prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Overview: Redesign the story screen into a story scroll layout showcasing pet paths before selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Discover Your Perfect Desktop Companion"}}
1: [sign_in, incentive] Sign In Pet Perks Banner: Display a account perk badge on the sign-in screen highlighting cross-desktop cloud saving.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to keep your pet synchronized and safe across re-installs.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Cloud Backup Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Mood Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated companion mood preview screen right after pick_friend to show animated pet behaviors.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_mood_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_mood_preview": {"headline": "Preview Pet Personality & Actions", "layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel and estimated time indicator to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 8, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Control Walkthrough: Replace static home welcome content with an interactive control checklist for moving, talking, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "label": "Practice calling, moving, and hiding your desktop pet", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout: Transform the pick_friend layout into a structured grid format with visual pet choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Timeout Notice: Show an automatic readiness status notification on the sign-in screen to inform users if sign-in stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "hint": "Connecting securely to account services..."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Step Counter: Display explicit step counters and a time estimate on choose_path to set quick completion expectations.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Choose Your Companion Path (Step 1 of 3)"}}
8: [adoption, reorder] Adoption Certificate Early Confirmation: Reorder adoption_certificate to appear before photo uploading to solidify pet naming early.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "adoption_certificate", "upload_photos", "waiting", "home_intro"], "adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Name"}}
9: [finish, hint] Taskbar Docking System Hint: Add an explicit taskbar badge and hint explaining where the pet docks on the desktop screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Your pet active icon is docked in your desktop system menu bar. Click anytime to interact or hide!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "System Tray Enabled", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen layout while preserving its core function of introducing the pet within onboarding.
Adds a cloud backup badge on sign-in without mentioning pricing, discounts, or violating fair design principles.
Inserts a new pet behavior preview screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.
Enhances the waiting screen with a tip carousel and progress indicator, which is explicitly allowed.
Replaces static home intro welcome content with an interactive control checklist within onboarding.
Redesigns pick_friend layout into a structured grid format while keeping pet selection functional.
Adds readiness status notifications to the sign-in screen as permitted within onboarding modifications.
Adds step counter and completion time estimates to choose_path without creating false urgency or dark patterns.
Reorders adoption certificate ahead of photo upload within onboarding while preserving all required steps.
Adds a taskbar docking hint and badge to the home intro screen within onboarding bounds.
